style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: the bag is tan canvas and the jug honey-amber plastic, one kraft and honey family: kraft keys, a magenta-marker Enter as the treat of the same world, butter soft keys, a light panel; never red or violet

images.why: Look: 'a measuring jug marked in millilitres' and Stage: 'the measuring jug stands at x 820, y 420, 160 wide and 260 tall, its marks and numbers in near-black ink'. The jug is the object the child pours from and reads; one jug drawn once, its body smooth and unmarked so the level and every mark are drawn in code.
images.prompt: A tall measuring jug standing upright, shown from the front so its whole height and side profile can be seen, moulded in glossy opaque honey-amber caramel plastic. It has straight smooth round sides, a small pouring spout at the rim and one curved handle on the right.

images.why: Stage: 'columns for a long jump, a school bag's weight and a drink of water' and phase 3: 'three weights on the chart in kilograms and grams'. One school bag drawn beside each weight in the bag column, so the weights are of bags and never of children; its weight is written in code.
images.prompt: A child's school backpack in smooth warm mustard-tan canvas, standing upright and shown from the front. It has a rounded top flap, one front pocket, two short shoulder straps and a small carrying handle.
